findings.title: Place Button styles in the component cascade layer
findings.reachableUseCase: A consumer applies utility-layer styles to Button; unlayered component rules do not participate in the declared Primer layer order.
findings.observedGap: The authored CSS Module contains no cascade-layer declaration, although ADR-021 and ADR-022 require component styles to use the named primer.components layer.
findings.additiveFix: Place the component style rules in @layer primer.components.Button; retain any globally scoped registrations and all existing selectors and declarations.
